name: Gattinger's lobelia
desc: Gattinger's lobelia (Lobelia gattingeri): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 80 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Lobelia gattingeri is a species of flowering plant in the bellflower family commonly called Gattinger's lobelia. It is endemic to calcareous cedar glades and barrens.
